text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with K.S. Miracle—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Paka Petit. ...Hehe, they're so cute, 
aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction of K.S.Miracle's 
gaze, there was a crane game filled with 
plushies modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if putting this in the hospital 
playroom would make everyone happy...
choice_data_list: Why don't you give it a try?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I hope it goes well... but I'll give it my 
best shot.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... It really is tough, isn't it? 
I've never really played games before, 
so...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. I will try to take on the 
challenge again someday.
choice_data_list: I'll get it for you instead!
I'll get it for you instead!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Oh no, I'd feel bad! I'm really 
okay, honestly.
choice_data_list:
Don't you want to make everyone at the 
hospital happy?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Trainer. ...Would it be okay to 
ask a favor?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
